ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface with sparse, high-intensity (white) clusters located primarily at the distal tips and as central mottling; estimated macro-ratio of white-to-black pixels is approximately 1:12.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigment across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white circular clusters (mottling) located in the mid-ventral region of the left lobe and lower-central region of the right lobe. High-intensity white banding observed on the outer distal tips of both fluke lobes.
